text:
# Pre-market brief: Mon 2026-11-16 (as of ~8:15 AM ET)

1. **AI/chip selloff extends into NVDA week.** NQ futures down ~1.0–1.5%, ES down ~0.4–0.7%, Dow ~flat ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-november-16-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-oil-091631084.html), [Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/sp-500-nasdaq-futures-slide-as-nvidia-earnings-anthropic-debut-loom-5028900)). NVDA is down ~2–3.5% pre on an FT report that Huang is weighing a return as CEO. It reports 11/17 at about 4:20 PM. INTC, AMD, AVGO, and MU are down 3.5–5%, CRWV and NBIS ~5.5%, and DELL/HPQ ~5% (Reuters). Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading Thu ([Boston Report](https://thebostonreport.com/2026/11/15/stock-market-week-ahead-nvidia-walmart-fed-minutes-nov-16-20-2026/)).
2. **INTC** is down ~5% pre on a securities class action over PC demand and inventory ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-intel-fall-jj-gains-5029397)). It's already in avoid.
3. **Crypto rout:** BTC fell below $62k Sat (-17% in Nov), now ~$64k. MSTR is down ~8% pre and COIN ~6% ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/11/16/live-news-bitcoin-posts-sixth-weekly-loss-as-tech-stocks-and-metals-slide), [Zaobao](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/en/finance/world/us-stock-futures-fall-monday-focus-turns-nvidia-earnings-expectations)). The whole crypto group goes in avoid.
4. **Rates/oil:** 10-yr 5.131% (-2bp), 2-yr 4.84% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/treasury-yields-bonds-inflation.html)). A Dec hike is fully priced (Reuters). Brent ~$94, lower (Yahoo).
5. **Other movers:** TSN beat Q4 (adj EPS $0.61, rev $14.59B), but its FY27 revenue guide is -3.5% to -5.5% vs about -1% est. Shares flat to +1% pre ([Reuters](https://www.streetinsider.com/Reuters/Tyson+Foods+forecasts+steeper-than-expected+annual+revenue+decline/27348250.html)) → avoid. SMMT -17% on an FDA CRL ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-16-2026)). JNJ +1.1% on a possible $3.4B Ollin deal (FT via Investing). TTWO +3% ahead of GTA VI on Thu ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)).

**Today:** Empire State 8:30, Fed Chair Warsh at noon, Hammack speaks.
**Week ahead (Boston Report/Schwab):** Tue: retail sales 8:30, IP 9:15, HD/DIS BMO, NVDA AMC. Wed: housing starts 8:30, FOMC minutes 2:00, TJX/LOW/TGT BMO, PANW AMC. Thu: claims/Philly Fed 8:30, WMT/BABA BMO, INTU/ROST AMC, Anthropic debut. Fri: UMich final 10:00, BJ BMO.

**Swing ideas** (Nasdaq-shock day, so lessons say no new longs at the open):
- **TTWO** (CONDITIONAL): enter at the 11/16 close only if the pre-market gain holds. GTA VI ships 11/19, and Jefferies reiterated Buy with a $300 PT (CNBC). Confidence: low. Risk: sell-the-news at release, and it's a reiteration, not an upgrade.
